lines.en: label kaoridate25:
I tap on Kaori’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我点下手机里 Kaori 的名字，等她接起来。

lines.en: And, all jokes aside, I hope there’s no giant cock involved this time.
lines.zh: 玩笑归玩笑，这次我希望别再牵扯到什么巨大的 cock 了。

lines.en: It’s one thing to dedicate an entire night of my potentially unending life to finding a lost chicken, but I think two nights spent on that might be pushing it.
lines.zh: 用我这段可能没有尽头的人生里的一整晚去找一只走失的鸡，是一回事；可要是为此花上两晚，我觉得就有点过了。

lines.en: Not to mention I still have no idea how things really ended up after we found John.
lines.zh: 更别说，我们找到 John 之后事情到底是怎么收场的，我到现在也没弄明白。

lines.en: Or why he suddenly has an affinity for saying Maya-esque things despite at least my {i}perceived{/i} understanding that he has not been spending lifetimes watching his chicken friends fall for someone else.
lines.zh: 也不明白他为什么突然爱说些 Maya 风格的话——至少{i}据我所知{/i}，他可没有花上好几辈子，看着自己的鸡朋友们一个个爱上别人。

lines.en: I wonder if they’ll return along with summer.
lines.zh: 我不知道它们会不会随着夏天一起回来。

lines.en: I wonder if his {i}voice{/i} will as well.
lines.zh: 我不知道他的{i}声音{/i}会不会也一起回来。

lines.en: But, like many other minor aspects of my existence, that’s something I’m willing to part with.
lines.zh: 不过，就像我生命中许多别的细枝末节一样，这也是我愿意放手的东西。

lines.en: I find that keeping a mental list of those things can be quite beneficial in terms of ensuring you don’t accidentally wind up hurt while stumbling down this ghost town, life.
lines.zh: 我发现，在心里列一张这样的清单相当有用，可以确保你在这座名叫「人生」的鬼城里跌跌撞撞时，不会不小心受了伤。

lines.en: Not all stars become supernovae. But when you find one that will, it’s best to get as far away as possible.
lines.zh: 不是所有恒星都会变成超新星。可一旦发现有一颗会，最好还是离得越远越好。

lines.en: Being caught in the blast of anything is risky.
lines.zh: 被任何东西的爆炸波及，都是件冒险的事。

lines.en: But, then again-
lines.zh: 不过，话说回来——

lines.en: So is something as menial and unimportant as dialing the number of a friend.
lines.zh: 拨通一个朋友的电话这种微不足道的小事，也一样冒险。

lines.en: Something somewhere explodes.
lines.zh: 某个地方，有什么东西爆炸了。

lines.en: : Phone call!
lines.zh: : 电话！

lines.en: : Hey, Kaori. What are you up to right now?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Kaori。你这会儿在干什么？

lines.en: : I do not know!
lines.zh: : 我不知道！

lines.en: : What do you mean you don’t know?
lines.zh: : 什么叫你不知道？

lines.en: : Well, it all started with a white cat.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这一切都是从一只白猫开始的。

lines.en: : I was on my way home from one of my working places when it was using its beanholders to try and capture a bakeryfly. It was very cute!
lines.zh: : 我从其中一个上班的地方回家的路上，它正用它的豆子托，想要抓住一只面包蝇。非常可爱！

lines.en: : Okay?
lines.zh: : 然后呢？

lines.en: : So cute that I chased after it and wound up somewhere unfamiliar!
lines.zh: : 可爱到我就追了上去，结果跑到了一个陌生的地方！

lines.en: : And now I do not know how to return home!
lines.zh: : 现在我不知道该怎么回家了！

lines.en: : Thankfully, I put a special lock on the door that prevents John from leaving, so he can not disappear again.
lines.zh: : 幸好我在门上装了一把特殊的锁，不让 John 出去，这样他就不会再消失了。

lines.en: : I will have to hope that my neighbor feeds him when they realize I am deceased.
lines.zh: : 我只能指望邻居发现我已经死了之后，会去喂他。

lines.en: : You are not going to die, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 你不会死的，Kaori。

lines.en: : We all die, Friend. It is something I learned by spending time with you.
lines.zh: : 我们都会死，朋友。这是我和你待在一起时学到的。

lines.en: : Okay well, that makes it sound like I’m the reason you learned that and that it wasn’t something that you just happened to learn while I was around.
lines.zh: : 好吧，这话听起来像是说你学到这件事是因为我，而不是刚好我在场的时候你碰巧学到的。

lines.en: : But if you’re actually lost, why not use a navigation app or something?
lines.zh: : 不过如果你真的迷路了，为什么不用个导航应用什么的？

lines.en: : My phone is dead!
lines.zh: : 我的手机死了！

lines.en: : Like all things...
lines.zh: : 就像所有东西一样……

lines.en: : But you’re talking to me on it right now.
lines.zh: : 可你现在正用它跟我说话啊。

lines.en: : Lightbulb!
lines.zh: : 灯泡！

lines.en: : What if I describe the things I see and you go on a hunt of the scavenging variety to locate me?
lines.zh: : 那我把我看到的东西描述出来，你去来一场搜寻式的打猎，把我找出来，怎么样？

lines.en: : Fine. Go.
lines.zh: : 行。说吧。

lines.en: : I spy with my little vision balls...stars! And...buildings!
lines.zh: : 我用我小小的视觉球看到了……星星！还有……楼房！

lines.en: : But they are not very good buildings. They are brown-ish. And...there is a wall! But there are many walls in many places, and not all of them keep things out!
lines.zh: : 可它们不是很好的楼房。它们有点发棕。还有……有一堵墙！不过很多地方都有很多墙，而且不是所有墙都能把东西挡在外面！

lines.en: : There is a...water crossing street extension! And...wires!
lines.zh: : 有一条……过水的街道延伸段！还有……电线！

lines.en: : Lots and lots of wires!
lines.zh: : 好多好多电线！

lines.en: : Wires and wires and wires and wires and-
lines.zh: : 电线、电线、电线、电线还——

lines.en: : Wait, are you in the old district?
lines.zh: : 等等，你是在老城区吗？

lines.en: : I do not know! Is that where cats go?
lines.zh: : 我不知道！猫是去那儿吗？

lines.en: : “Water crossing street extension” means bridge, right?
lines.zh: : 「过水的街道延伸段」说的是桥吧？

lines.en: : You are very good at learning! Congratulations!
lines.zh: : 你学东西真快！恭喜！

lines.en: : I think I know where you are, I just have no idea how you made it all the way over there just by chasing an animal.
lines.zh: : 我想我知道你在哪儿了，只是完全不明白你光是追一只动物，怎么会一路跑到那么远的地方。

lines.en: : Animals can be very fast and have large amounts of stamina! Unless you are referring to the cheetah, which is an animal built for speed but {i}not{/i} stamina!
lines.zh: : 动物可以跑得很快，而且耐力十足！除{i}非{/i}你说的是猎豹——那种为速度而非耐力而生的动物！

lines.en: : This cat was not a cheetah, though. It was much smaller. But did you know that cheetahs-
lines.zh: : 不过那只猫不是猎豹。它小多了。可你知道吗，猎豹——

lines.en: : Just stay where you are, Kaori. I’ll come and find you.
lines.zh: : 你待在原地别动就好，Kaori。我去找你。

lines.en: : Thank you, Friend! I wanted to ask for help, but I have not yet discovered how to use my arm feet to make your phone go bzzzzzzzzzzz and always have to wait for mine to do that!
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，朋友！我本来想求救的，可我还没弄明白该怎么用我的胳膊脚让你的手机发出 bzzzzzzzzzzz，所以只好一直等着我自己的响！

lines.en: : I’ll teach you soon. Just...stay where you are.
lines.zh: : 我很快就教你。只是……待在那儿别动。

lines.en: : Okay! Phone call!
lines.zh: : 好的！电话！

lines.en: I hang up the phone and sigh to myself, knowing that I’ve got a long way to walk if I’m going to find Kaori.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，暗自叹了口气，知道要找到 Kaori，还得走很长一段路。

lines.en: I just hope that she doesn’t wind up wandering off and that she actually stays where I asked her to.
lines.zh: 我只希望她别乱走，真的待在我让她待的地方。

lines.en: The second half of town is the last place anyone like her should put themselves this late at night.
lines.zh: 这座城市的后半区，是像她这样的人在这么晚的时候最不该待的地方。

lines.en: {i}I{/i} don’t even like being there this late at night and I’m probably twice her size in terms of weight.
lines.zh: 这么晚{i}我{/i}都不喜欢待在那儿，而论体重，我大概是她的两倍。

lines.en: Here goes nothing, I guess.
lines.zh: 管他呢，走吧。

lines.en: I think of the phrase someone important uttered at some point that goes, “Nothing ventured, nothing gained” and attempt to connect it to my current situation in a meaningful way.
lines.zh: 我想起某个重要的人在什么时候说过的那句「不入虎穴，焉得虎子」，并试图把它和我眼下的处境有意义地联系起来。

lines.en: The connection is severed once I remember that I am the living antithesis to that quote, who gains everything from doing nothing but has the potential to be wiped clean if those operations were flipped.
lines.zh: 可一想到我自己就是这句话活生生的反面——什么都不做却得到一切，而一旦把这个运作方式反过来，就有可能被彻底抹除——这层联系就断了。

lines.en: Instead of thinking at all, I walk.
lines.zh: 于是什么都不想，我只是走。

lines.en: scene kaoribridge1
And I arrive.
lines.zh: 然后，我到了。

lines.en: Kaori stands at the railing of a bridge where I once met someone she’s forgotten.
lines.zh: Kaori 站在一座桥的栏杆旁，而我曾在那座桥上见过一个她已经忘记的人。

lines.en: She looks up at the sky and thinks of something- probably animals. But I think of something else.
lines.zh: 她抬头望着天空，想着什么——大概是动物。可我想的是别的。

lines.en: Something impure, though not the type of impurity you’d typically associate with me.
lines.zh: 某种不洁的东西，虽然不是人们通常会和我联系在一起的那种不洁。

lines.en: I think of what it would be like to shove both her consciousness and mine into a blender and deliver it unto the people of this place through telephone wires.
lines.zh: 我想着，要是把她和我的意识一起塞进搅拌机，再通过电话线送到这个地方的人们手里，会是什么样子。

lines.en: If those devoid of life could have life itself injected back into them, I wonder what it would do for this place.
lines.zh: 如果那些没有生命的东西能被重新注入生命，我不知道这会给这个地方带来什么。

lines.en: And I wonder what would become of us, who sacrificed everything so they could do that.
lines.zh: 我也不知道，为了让它们能那样而牺牲了一切的我们，会变成什么样。

lines.en: I give up the thought as it’s not my choice to dictate what this girl wastes her mind on.
lines.zh: 我放弃了这个念头，因为她把心思浪费在什么上，轮不到我来决定。

lines.en: Not while it’s still blooming.
lines.zh: 至少在它还在绽放的时候不行。

lines.en: Not while mine has already withered.
lines.zh: 至少在我的那份早已枯萎的时候不行。

lines.en: scene kaoribridge2
I take my place beside her and gaze up at the same sky.
lines.zh: 我在她身边站定，抬头望着同一片天空。

lines.en: We see different things.
lines.zh: 我们看见的是不同的东西。

lines.en: : I did as you asked, Friend. I did not move at all.
lines.zh: : 我照你说的做了，朋友。我一步都没动。

lines.en: : And it was very hard because I saw a frog.
lines.zh: : 而且这非常难，因为我看到了一只青蛙。

lines.en: : Do you like frogs?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢青蛙吗？

lines.en: : They’re fine, I guess.
lines.zh: : 还行吧，大概。

lines.en: : Did you know that frogs have nightvision? And that one of the reasons they are so good at hunting tiny bugs is because they are very sensitive to movement?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，青蛙有夜视能力？还有，它们之所以那么擅长捕捉小虫子，其中一个原因就是它们对移动非常敏感？

lines.en: : When a frog captures its dinner, it will even pull its eyes down to the ceiling of its frog mouth to push the food down its throat! It is a very impressive way to eat!
lines.zh: : 青蛙抓住晚饭的时候，甚至会把眼睛往下拉到它青蛙嘴的顶上，好把食物推进喉咙！这是一种非常了不起的吃法！

lines.en: : Is there anything special you use your eyes for, Friend?
lines.zh: : 你的眼睛有什么特别的用途吗，朋友？

lines.en: : Nothing as special as sending them down to the roof of my mouth.
lines.zh: : 没什么特别的用途，比不上把眼睛送到口腔顶上那么特别。

lines.en: : You probably can not do that because you have a chicken brain. And chickens just have normal eyes. Which means you probably have chicken eyes too.
lines.zh: : 你大概做不到，因为你长了个鸡脑子。而鸡只有普通的眼睛。这也就是说，你大概也长了一对鸡的眼睛。

lines.en: : Maybe you are just a large chicken who plucks his feathers?
lines.zh: : 也许你只是一只拔光了自己羽毛的大鸡？

lines.en: : Did you know that birds will pluck their own feathers to cope with stress when-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，鸟类会拔自己的羽毛来应对压力，当——

lines.en: : You need to be more careful, Kaori. You getting lost somewhere like this in the middle of the night isn’t really something I want to deal with regularly.
lines.zh: : 你得再小心一点，Kaori。你大半夜在这种地方迷路，这可真不是我想经常应付的事。

lines.en: : Same goes for John, I guess. But you matter to me a little more than he does.
lines.zh: : John 大概也一样。不过你对我来说，比他要重要那么一点。

lines.en: : I am sorry for making you sadburger.
lines.zh: : 对不起，我让你变成伤心堡了。

lines.en: : I didn’t know I would get lost.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道自己会迷路。

lines.en: : Recently, my mind has been very {i}zizz zizz{/i} and I thought petting a kitten would make it more {i}pow pow{/i}. Do you understand?
lines.zh: : 最近我的脑子一直很 {i}zizz zizz{/i}，我以为摸摸小猫能让它变得 {i}pow pow{/i}。你懂吗？

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 不懂。

lines.en: : I will try a little harder to keep your life easy, Friend.
lines.zh: : 我会更努力一点，让你的生活轻松些，朋友。

lines.en: scene spiderbug
scene kaoribridge3
: Know that I am with you always. To the end of time.
lines.zh: : 要知道，我会永远和你在一起。直到时间的尽头。

lines.en: : Or at least until I get tired of finding you.
lines.zh: : 或者，至少到我懒得再找你为止。

lines.en: : You will always find me, whether you want to or not! I do not want to disappear, but it is something that can happen!
lines.zh: : 不管你愿不愿意，你总会找到我的！我不想消失，可这种事是有可能发生的！

lines.en: : Make it...not happen, then? It’s fine on nights like tonight when I’m not really doing anything but, if this were to happen again tomorrow, I can’t say I’d really come out searching.
lines.zh: : 那就……别让它发生？像今晚这样我本来就没什么事的时候还好，可要是明天又来一次，我可不敢说真的会出来找。

lines.en: : But you would!
lines.zh: : 可你会的！

lines.en: : Why do you sound so certain of that when I’m literally telling you that’s not how it would work?
lines.zh: : 我都明说了事情不是这么运作的，你为什么听起来还这么肯定？

lines.en: : If a man owns a hundred sheep, and one of them wanders away, will he not leave the ninety-nine on the hills and go to look for the one that wandered off?
lines.zh: : 一个人若有一百只羊，其中一只走迷了路，他岂不把这九十九只留在山上，去找那只走迷的羊吗？

lines.en: : Since when do you know about metaphors?
lines.zh: : 你什么时候开始懂比喻了？

lines.en: scene kaoribridge4
: I will continue to make trouble for you because that is who I am. I am a troublesome girl. So much trouble.
lines.zh: : 我会继续给你添麻烦，因为这就是我。我是个麻烦的女孩。特别麻烦。

lines.en: : But it is you who continues to find me even when you are not looking that makes me so sure you will find me again.
lines.zh: : 可正是因为你在没有刻意寻找的时候，还是一次次找得到我，我才这么确定，你还会再找到我。

lines.en: : To the end of time, Friend.
lines.zh: : 直到时间的尽头，朋友。

lines.en: : And even after that.
lines.zh: : 甚至在那之后。

lines.en: Kaori stares off at the sky once again and I can’t help but-
lines.zh: Kaori 再次望向天空出神，而我忍不住——

lines.en: : I am hungry.
lines.zh: : 我饿了。

lines.en: : Okay, I guess I can finish my inner monologue later.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我看我的内心独白可以留到以后再讲完。

lines.en: : Do you know of any establishments in this strange part of the world that will feed me at this time of night?
lines.zh: : 你知道这个世界这个奇怪的角落里，有什么店在这么晚还会给我东西吃吗？

lines.en: : I mean, there’s a ramen shop not far from here that I- wait, haven’t you been there before?
lines.zh: : 这个嘛，离这儿不远有家拉面店，我——等等，你以前不是去过吗？

lines.en: scene kaoribridge5
: Noodle building...
lines.zh: : 面条楼……

lines.en: : Is that angry face because you hate noodles or because you’re still upset Tsuneyo wouldn’t hire you?
lines.zh: : 你这张生气的脸，是因为讨厌面条，还是因为还在为 Tsuneyo 不肯雇你而难过？

lines.en: : Yes!
lines.zh: : 都是！

lines.en: : There is something strange about that building. Strange about this place. It makes my insides buzz like they are full of bees.
lines.zh: : 那栋楼有点奇怪。这地方也有点奇怪。它让我的内脏嗡嗡作响，就像里面装满了蜜蜂。

lines.en: : Well, if you want food around here, it’s either that or the convenience store. I don’t really want to scout out any new local businesses at this time of night- especially when most of them are probably defunct.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你要是在这附近想吃东西，不是那儿就是便利店。这么晚我可不想再去探什么新店——尤其是这里的大多数店大概早就关门大吉了。

lines.en: scene kaoribridge6
: Mmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm!
lines.zh: : Mmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm！

lines.en: : Okay!
lines.zh: : 好吧！

lines.en: : But you must protect me from the evil that is the attractive ramen girl! She has access to too many sharp objects and an ingrained dislike for spiders!
lines.zh: : 但你必须保护我，免遭那个有魅力的拉面女孩的毒手！她手边有太多锋利的东西，而且骨子里就讨厌蜘蛛！

lines.en: : Just keep your shirt on and I’m sure there won’t be any problems, then.
lines.zh: : 只要你好好穿着衣服，我保证不会有什么问题。

lines.en: : If only things were that easy, Friend.
lines.zh: : 要是事情都这么简单就好了，朋友。

lines.en: : If only things were that easy...
lines.zh: : 要是事情都这么简单就好了……

lines.en: scene black
After another minute or two of silent reflection as we gaze up at the sky, Kaori and I pull ourselves away from the bridge and begin to make our way over to Tojo Ramen.
lines.zh: 我们又抬头望着天空沉默了一两分钟，然后 Kaori 和我才离开那座桥，动身往 Tojo Ramen 去。

lines.en: It’s late enough that Tsuneyo should be closing up soon, but there should still be enough time for Kaori and I to get there and order before it becomes too much of a burden.
lines.zh: 时候已经很晚了，Tsuneyo 应该快要打烊，不过时间大概还够我和 Kaori 赶过去点单，不至于太给人添麻烦。

lines.en: Not like I really care about being a burden anyway.
lines.zh: 反正我也没那么在乎是不是给人添麻烦。

lines.en: I helped someone tonight, so it’s only fair that I trouble someone else to cancel that out.
lines.zh: 今晚我帮了别人，那么去麻烦别人一次、把这笔账抵消掉，也算公平。

lines.en: Kaori and I make our way through the overgrown streets of the second half of town and I notice her forcing herself to not chase after every living creature she spots.
lines.zh: 我和 Kaori 穿过后半区那些杂草丛生的街道，我注意到她在努力克制自己，不去追每一个她看到的活物。

lines.en: The ones with extra legs, at least.
lines.zh: 至少是那些腿多出来的。

lines.en: The humans who cling to the sides of old houses or tuck themselves into alleyways seem to be nearly invisible to her.
lines.zh: 那些贴在老房子边上、或是缩在小巷里的人类，对她来说几乎是不存在的。

lines.en: The opposite goes for them, however, who pay closer attention to her movements than I’ve seen them pay to anything else for as long as I’ve been coming here.
lines.zh: 可对那些人来说刚好相反——自从我来这儿以来，我从没见过他们对什么东西，像关注她的一举一动那样关注过。

lines.en: If it means something, I don’t know what. And I’m far too tired to try and figure it out.
lines.zh: 如果这意味着什么，我也不知道是什么。而且我太累了，根本懒得去弄明白。

lines.en: So I will swallow my tongue and keep quiet until we arrive, locking any lingering thoughts so far in the back of my mind that even you will not be able to find them.
lines.zh: 所以我会闭上嘴，一路安静到目的地，把那些挥之不去的念头锁进脑海最深处，深到连你都找不到。

lines.en: scene kaoribridge7
: Welcome to Tojo Ramen. Please take a seat wherever you would like. The options are limitless.
lines.zh: : 欢迎光临 Tojo Ramen。请随意入座。选择是无限的。

lines.en: : Yo. What are you two doing here this late? Tsu-chan was just about to close up.
lines.zh: : 哟。你俩这么晚来这儿干嘛？Tsu-chan 正准备打烊呢。

lines.en: scene kaoribridge8
: Kaori got lost after chasing a cat. Then she got hungry. Now we’re here.
lines.zh: : Kaori 追猫追迷路了。然后她饿了。所以我们就来了。

lines.en: : Yeah, okay. That tracks.
lines.zh: : 是啊，好吧。这就说得通了。

lines.en: : Shoulda told me. I would’ve came and got her if I knew. Would’ve saved you a whole ass trip.
lines.zh: : 你早该跟我说。我要是知道，就去接她了。也省得你跑这一大趟。

lines.en: : I’ll do that next time now that she’s practically assured me there will be another.
lines.zh: : 下次我会的，既然她几乎已经向我保证还会有下一次。

lines.en: scene kaoribridge9
: You look familiar.
lines.zh: : 你看着眼熟。

lines.en: : This is the {i}other{/i} girl related to Yuki who came in looking for a job that you refused to hire.
lines.zh: : 这就是和 Yuki 有关系的{i}另一个{/i}女孩，之前来找工作，你拒绝了。

lines.en: : What a persistent and irritating family.
lines.zh: : 真是执着又烦人的一家人。

lines.en: : Hey.
: Do you require a menu? Or are the many items listed on our walls sufficient in guiding your decision?
lines.zh: : 您需要菜单吗？还是说，我们墙上列出的许多菜品，已经足够指引您做出决定了？

lines.en: : Just make me whatever. I don’t really care.
lines.zh: : 随便给我做点什么吧。我真不在乎。

lines.en: : I will have...
lines.zh: : 我要……

lines.en: : Tori shio ramen!
lines.zh: : Tori shio ramen！

lines.en: : Tori shio?
lines.zh: : Tori shio？

lines.en: : Ain’t that your old man’s favorite, Tsu-chan? Remember him always makin’ that for himself back in the day.
lines.zh: : 那不是你老爸最爱吃的吗，Tsu-chan？记得他以前老给自己做这个。

lines.en: : That dish is not one that is displayed on our wall. How did you know of it?
lines.zh: : 这道菜并不在我们墙上展示的菜品里。你是怎么知道的？

lines.en: : I mean, it ain’t really a weird dish to order, is it?
lines.zh: : 我是说，点这道菜又不算稀奇，对吧？

lines.en: : I am simply curious. That is all.
lines.zh: : 我只是好奇。仅此而已。

lines.en: : I am a friend of chickens! It is my duty to make sure their sacrifices for our sake do not go to waste!
lines.zh: : 我是鸡的朋友！确保它们为我们做出的牺牲不被浪费，是我的职责！

lines.en: scene kaoribridge10
: Is it truly a sacrifice if they die unwillingly?
lines.zh: : 如果它们死得并不情愿，那还能算是牺牲吗？

lines.en: : Does terminating the life-contracts of innocent creatures bring joy to your blood muscle?
lines.zh: : 终止无辜生物的生命契约，会让你的血液肌肉感到快乐吗？

lines.en: : The heart can feel no joy. It is the brain that processes emotions. You are clearly not prepared for the dish you ordered.
lines.zh: : 心脏感受不到快乐。处理情绪的是大脑。你显然没有做好吃你点的这道菜的准备。

lines.en: scene kaoribridge11
: I didn’t realize there were dishes you needed to pass a test in order to...order here.
lines.zh: : 我不知道在这儿点菜，还得先通过一场考试才能……点。

lines.en: : Tojo Ramen reserves the right to refuse service to anyone. For the protection of my family’s restaurant, I must ask that you order something else.
lines.zh: : Tojo Ramen 保留拒绝为任何人提供服务的权利。为了保护我家这家餐厅，我必须请您换一道菜。

lines.en: : I’m no ramen expert but I think fixing your ongoing power issues should be a little higher on the priority list when it comes to defending your family’s restaurant than refusing customers.
lines.zh: : 我不是拉面专家，不过说到保护你家的餐厅，我觉得先修好你们一直以来的电力问题，优先级应该比拒绝顾客高一点。

lines.en: : Oh, I think those are taken care of. I helped out with some of the wiring and shit downstairs earlier today and it’s been fine ever since.
lines.zh: : 哦，那些我觉得已经解决了。今天早些时候我帮忙弄了楼下一些线路什么的，从那以后一直都挺好的。

lines.en: : Tori shio ramen! Save the chickens!
lines.zh: : Tori shio ramen！拯救那些鸡！

lines.en: : You are a confusing individual. Why cling to something you do not understand? Something you have never experienced?
lines.zh: : 你是个让人困惑的人。为什么要执着于你并不理解的东西？你从未体验过的东西？

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, it’s just soup.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，那只是一碗汤而已。

lines.en: scene kaoribridge12
: First, ah!
lines.zh: : 首先，啊！

lines.en: : Second, {i}just{/i} soup?! Have you no shame?!
lines.zh: : 其次，{i}只是{/i}一碗汤？！你就不知道害臊吗？！

lines.en: : I think that dish might just be important to Tsu-chan because of her dad. Ain’t ever really seen somebody else order it.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那道菜对 Tsu-chan 来说可能挺重要的，因为她爸爸。我还真没见过别人点过。

lines.en: : Do not make me go to the Yelp! I do not know what it is, but I know that these words instill fear in the brainhearts of my managers!
lines.zh: : 别逼我去找 Yelp！我不知道那是什么，但我知道这些话会在我店长们的脑心里灌满恐惧！

lines.en: scene kaoribridge13
: Tch. So that is how this is going to be.
lines.zh: : 啧。看来是要这样了。

lines.en: : I should have known you would play dirty when you reek of arachnids.
lines.zh: : 你一身蛛形纲动物的臭味，我早该知道你会玩阴的。

lines.en: : Do spiders even have a scent?
lines.zh: : 蜘蛛有气味吗？

lines.en: : Everything has a scent if you close your eyes and imagine it has a scent!
lines.zh: : 只要你闭上眼睛、想象它有气味，什么都有气味！

lines.en: : Very well. I will make you what you ordered. But I bid you fair warning that I have never made this dish before and would highly implore you to order something else.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我会给你做你点的那道菜。不过我得先郑重警告你：这道菜我从没做过，还是强烈建议你换一道。

lines.en: : I will glue that to the inside of my brain with imaginary glue and {i}un{/i}glue it once I have saved all of the chickens in Kumon-mi!
lines.zh: : 我会用想象出来的胶水，把这句话粘在我的大脑内侧，等我把 Kumon-mi 所有的鸡都救出来之后，再把它{i}撕下来{/i}！

lines.en: scene kaoribridge14
: Why save what is doomed from the start?
lines.zh: : 为什么要去救那些从一开始就注定要完蛋的东西？

lines.en: : Why abandon those who need us most?
lines.zh: : 为什么要抛弃那些最需要我们的人？

lines.en: : Why is this conversation still happening?
lines.zh: : 为什么这段对话还在继续？

lines.en: scene black
{i}Why does everything have to hurt so much?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}为什么一切都非得这么疼？{/i}

lines.en: : Yo, are you fuckin’ for real?!
lines.zh: : 哟，你他妈是认真的吗？！

lines.en: : You’ve gotta call your electric company or some shit, Tsuneyo. This is gettin’ out of hand.
lines.zh: : 你得给你的电力公司打个电话什么的，Tsuneyo。这有点收不住了。

lines.en: : Tojo Ramen sincerely apologizes for the inconvenience. Please remain calm while I attempt to restore the power.
lines.zh: : Tojo Ramen 诚挚地为给您带来的不便致歉。在我尝试恢复供电期间，请保持冷静。

lines.en: : Looks like we probably should have gone to the convenience store after all.
lines.zh: : 看来我们一开始就该去便利店的。

lines.en: : Why would we go there? We have all of the green onions we need and leaving work would not be convenient for anyone.
lines.zh: : 我们为什么要去那儿？我们需要的大葱全都有，而且下班走人对任何人来说都不方便。

lines.en: : I wasn’t talking about you, Tsuneyo. I was talking about Kaori and me.
lines.zh: : 我不是在说你，Tsuneyo。我说的是 Kaori 和我。

lines.en: : How rude of you to not invite me. I will not forget this.
lines.zh: : 你居然不邀请我，真是失礼。我不会忘记这件事的。

lines.en: : Aight, I’m gettin’ outta here. Just put my shit on my tab and I’ll pay you back next-
lines.zh: : 行了，我走了。把我的东西记在我账上，下——

lines.en: scene kaoribridge15
: JESUS fuck, that noise ain’t easy to get used to.
lines.zh: : 我操，这声音可真不容易习惯。

lines.en: : Wait, where’d Kaori go? She afraid of the dark or something?
lines.zh: : 等等，Kaori 去哪儿了？她怕黑还是怎么的？

lines.en: : I think she’s said something about that in the past, but...I don’t think she’d really run away because of a five second blackout.
lines.zh: : 我记得她以前提过类似的话，不过……我不觉得她会因为五秒钟的停电就真的跑掉。

lines.en: : Or how she could even find the door, now that I think about it.
lines.zh: : 再说了，现在想想，她是怎么找到门的？

lines.en: : Tsu-chan, you cool with puttin’ everything on my tab? That girl’s my niece and I probably shouldn’t be lettin’ her wander around in the dark over here.
lines.zh: : Tsu-chan，把所有的都记在我账上行吗？那女孩是我侄女，我大概不该任由她在这种地方摸黑乱走。

lines.en: : No offense but this part of town ain’t exactly the safest thing around.
lines.zh: : 无意冒犯，不过这一带可算不上什么安全的地方。

lines.en: : Tojo Ramen understands and thanks you for your patronage. Please rest assured that these blackouts will no longer happen after today.
lines.zh: : Tojo Ramen 理解并感谢您的惠顾。请放心，今天之后，这样的停电不会再发生了。

lines.en: : For the sake of my business, I can not allow this to continue.
lines.zh: : 为了我的生意，我不能允许这种事继续下去。

lines.en: : Yo, you comin’? Should probably help look for her since you’re the one who brought her here and all that shit.
lines.zh: : 哟，你来不来？毕竟是你把她带来的，你大概也该帮忙找找她什么的。

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Yeah, I’ll help.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我来帮忙。

lines.en: scene black
I follow Yuki out of Tojo Ramen burdened by the sensation of a large pit in my stomach.
lines.zh: 我跟着 Yuki 走出 Tojo Ramen，胃里沉甸甸地坠着一个大洞。

lines.en: By the time I make my way out into the open air, the pit grows.
lines.zh: 等我走到外面的空地上时，那个洞变得更大了。

lines.en: scene kaoribridge16
I’m unsure of exactly what it grows {i}into{/i}, however.
lines.zh: 不过我不太确定它到底长{i}成{/i}了什么。

lines.en: I can feel thin roots sinking into some organs I probably couldn’t name if they were placed on an autopsy table in front of me...and wonder how much of my body’s resources are being siphoned away by them.
lines.zh: 我能感觉到细小的根须扎进某些器官里——就算把它们摆在我面前的解剖台上，我大概也叫不出名字……而我在想，我身体里有多少养分正被它们吸走。

lines.en: I wonder if removing them would be as simple as removing weeds from a garden.
lines.zh: 我在想，拔掉它们是不是就像从花园里除草一样简单。

lines.en: A plucking motion- followed by a twist.
lines.zh: 一个拔的动作——再拧一下。

lines.en: A lift of the hand to observe the dirt falling off. To observe what wildlife clings to them, acting as yet another siphon.
lines.zh: 抬手看着泥土簌簌落下。看看上面还挂着什么野生的东西，充当又一根吸管。

lines.en: : Kaori? You around?
lines.zh: : Kaori？你在附近吗？

lines.en: : I’ll give you a ride home. Just need you to like...come out and shit.
lines.zh: : 我送你回家。你只要……出来什么的就行。

lines.en: I look, but I don’t look far.
lines.zh: 我四处看，却看得不远。

lines.en: I don’t know how, but I can tell we aren’t going to find her.
lines.zh: 我不知道为什么，但我就是知道，我们找不到她。

lines.en: Of course, I can’t bring myself to say that because I don’t want Yuki to worry.
lines.zh: 当然，这话我说不出口，因为我不想让 Yuki 担心。

lines.en: And I guess {i}I{/i} don’t want to worry either.
lines.zh: 而且{i}我{/i}大概也不想让自己担心。

lines.en: Everything will be okay.
lines.zh: 一切都会好起来的。

lines.en: Everything is normal.
lines.zh: 一切都很正常。

lines.en: scene kaoribridge17
Everything is normal.
lines.zh: 一切都很正常。

lines.en: scene black
Yuki gives up on searching and decides to go home.
lines.zh: Yuki 放弃了搜寻，决定回家。

lines.en: I do the same.
lines.zh: 我也一样。

lines.en: {i}Kaori’s aff____________________xxxxxxxxxxxxxxx{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Kaori 的好感____________________xxxxxxxxxxxxxxx{/i}

lines.en: scene kaoribridge18
Ami was sleeping on the couch when I came home.
lines.zh: 我回家的时候，Ami 正在沙发上睡觉。

lines.en: All of her clothes were off.
lines.zh: 她的衣服全脱了。

lines.en: She is getting so big.
lines.zh: 她长这么大了。

lines.en: scene black
Sleep.
lines.zh: 睡吧。
